attributes.action: Make Monday 6th July 2026 a one off bank holiday day
attributes.additional_details:
Make Mondays 6th July 2026 a one off bank holiday so proper can watch England in the next round of the World Cup. Similar things have happened in Scotland this year and around the world. 

Only in England do the public get considered last. 

Make your voice heard and make it count
attributes.background: Make Monday 6thJuly 2026 a bank holiday for the nation to follow the World Cup team. Bank holidays were given to the Scottish to cover their day. Why are we any different when we’re one British isles. Get behind the team and country. Unite us for 1 day only.

rejection.details: When our team got to your petition in the petitions queue, the date of the England vs Mexico World Cup game had already passed.
